$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors: a path relative to the file (e.g. ../schemas/request.schema.json, as 'stratarec schema --out schemas' writes them) or a URL. The engine ignores it: it is not part of the file's content id.

pipeline_id.description: The pipeline to run, by its pipeline_id.

request_id.description: Request id; it seeds the request's randomness when seed is absent. Defaults to "cli".

inputs.description: Values for the pipeline's request_schema, by name.

assignment.description: The arms the experiment platform answered, as "experiment/arm"; [] is the answer "no arms".

force_arms.description: Arms to force over the assignment, as "experiment/arm"; [] forces the baseline.

deadline_ms.description: End-to-end deadline in milliseconds; defaults to 1000.

time_ms.description: Request time in Unix milliseconds; defaults to now.

seed.description: Seed of the request's randomness; defaults to a hash of the request id.
